recipe.ghg_method: Fossil CO2 summed across seven native fuel accounts. Source Mt CO2eq converted to tonnes using 1e6. CO2 has GWP 1 under AR5 and AR6; no CH4, N2O or F-gases are included. No direct final-demand emissions are supplied.
recipe.gdp_basis: GDP proxy: value added (no product-tax detail in source)
recipe.gdp_note: EMERGING: GDP is approximated by value added. The source table does not break out product taxes, so no adjustment to market prices is applied.
recipe.value_added_note: Sum of the native value added row. The source table does not break out product taxes separately.
recipe.attribution: Huo, J.; Wang, W.; Guan, D. EMERGING 2.2, 2021. doi:10.5281/zenodo.19461860. CC BY 4.0; indicators calculated with MARIO.
recipe.ghg_basis: Fossil CO2 by fuel; incomplete GHG proxy
recipe.gwp_basis: CO2 only (GWP = 1 under AR5 and AR6)
recipe.ghg_note: EMERGING: GHG is a fossil CO2-only proxy (seven fuel accounts). CH4, N2O, F-gases and direct final-demand emissions are not included.

input_layout.instructions: Place the listed files together in a dedicated source directory. Do not add an optional labels workbook to this reading. The selected value-added runner does not require the CO2 companion; the full source companion does.

notes.gross_output: Native MARIO X for IOTs and Xc for SUTs, summed over producing nodes. Gross output includes intermediate production at multiple stages and is not GDP.
notes.domestic_use: Domestic-origin use within the same native region only: matching origin and destination regions in Z and Y (IOT) or U and Yc (SUT). Intermediate and final uses enter once; signed source adjustments are retained.
notes.final_demand: Final demand by consumer region from Y (IOT) or Yc (SUT). Domestic and Imported identify the supplying row region relative to that consumer. A shared SNA category vocabulary is used; native combined categories are never split or duplicated. Households + NPISH combines the observed household and NPISH source columns where separately supplied. EMERGING reports one household consumption category; its NPISH coverage is undocumented. The displayed value is the reported household amount, not a verified complete SNA Households + NPISH amount. No missing NPISH amount is treated as zero.
notes.value_added_footprint: Reviewed value added generated by domestic and foreign producers to meet final demand in the selected consumer region. Native direct coefficients retain production origins before MARIO calc_m_from_z solves the system. Multiplication by Y/Yc retains final-consumer columns; no full inverse is constructed.
notes.ghg_footprint: Allocable GHG supported by final demand in the consumer region, plus supplied direct final-user emissions once. MARIO calc_ghg uses the reviewed source characterisation, and calc_f_from_z retains production origins before multiplying by Y/Yc. Direct accounts and upstream requirements outside the representable final-demand boundary stay quantified by production origin. EMERGING: GHG is a fossil CO2-only proxy (seven fuel accounts). CH4, N2O, F-gases and direct final-demand emissions are not included.
notes.value_added_trade: Upstream value added embodied in signed gross intermediate and final-use crossings. Domestic and Foreign identify value added generated inside or outside the exporting native region. Total includes both and can closely match gross monetary trade in balanced systems. Repeated border crossings can count the same value added again; this is not value-added exports measured by ultimate foreign final absorption.
notes.ghg_trade: Upstream production GHG embodied in signed gross intermediate and final-use crossings. Repeated border crossings can count the same emissions again. Direct final-user emissions and unrepresented production accounts are not allocated to traded output. EMERGING: GHG is a fossil CO2-only proxy (seven fuel accounts). CH4, N2O, F-gases and direct final-demand emissions are not included.

sector_scope.boundary: Supplying industry/product of traded output or final demand
unassigned: commodities not specified according to kind
sector_scope.qualification: The selected sector identifies the supplying industry/product at the border or in final demand; upstream value added and emissions can arise in every industry. Mixed native groups are indivisible. Unassigned native groups remain separate; named sections show the identified mapped portion when an unassigned group exists.

A: Main-activity/product proxy: the complete native group is assigned to A. Additional reviewed scope: C. It remains within this whole-row proxy; no numerical split or measured dominance is asserted.
C: Main-activity/product proxy: the complete native group is assigned to C. Additional reviewed scope: A. It remains within this whole-row proxy; no numerical split or measured dominance is asserted.
Main-activity/product proxy: the complete native group is assigned to C. Additional reviewed scope: G+S. It remains within this whole-row proxy; no numerical split or measured dominance is asserted.
B: Main-activity/product proxy: the complete native group is assigned to B. Additional reviewed scope: C. It remains within this whole-row proxy; no numerical split or measured dominance is asserted.
Main-activity/product proxy: the complete native group is assigned to B. Additional reviewed scope: A+C. It remains within this whole-row proxy; no numerical split or measured dominance is asserted.
R: Main-activity/product proxy: the complete native group is assigned to R. Additional reviewed scope: G. It remains within this whole-row proxy; no numerical split or measured dominance is asserted.
E: Main-activity/product proxy: the complete native group is assigned to E. Additional reviewed scope: A+B. It remains within this whole-row proxy; no numerical split or measured dominance is asserted.
N: Main-activity/product proxy: the complete native group is assigned to N. Additional reviewed scope: J+M. It remains within this whole-row proxy; no numerical split or measured dominance is asserted.
